A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Latent Zoning Network work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G are sufficiently complete and readable for reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 3–5 and Appendices C–E report original image-generation, ImageNet representation-learning and CIFAR10 classification experiments, including ablations.

after.justification: The original experimental results in Sections 3–5 and Appendices C–E are retained, including benchmark outcomes, generated samples and ablations.

M1.justification: The latent computation and alignment procedures, encoder/decoder designs, objectives and training/inference algorithms are unchanged. The schematic revisions and expanded decoder cross-reference do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same image tasks using CIFAR10, AFHQ-Cat, CelebA-HQ, LSUN-Bedroom and ImageNet. Appendix G also retains the exploratory MNIST and CIFAR10 observations for standalone generation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the generation and classification tables, including the expanded ImageNet comparison in Table 6. Newly cited Diffusion Autoencoder and Distilled Decoding 2 are discussed as related work, without added evaluated comparisons.

E3.justification: The splits, metrics, sample counts, architectures, training settings and sampling procedures in Sections 3–5 and Appendices C–E are unchanged. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Both retain the analyses of FID implementations, sampling steps, representation choice, training iterations, joint training, classification batch size and latent randomness, and alignment cutoff u. Their evidence and tested questions are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both describe averaging 20 reconstructions per image in Appendix C.3. There are no changes to repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates, error bars or significance testing.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8, empirical plots and generated-sample results are unchanged. For example, both report unconditional CIFAR10 FIDs of 2.76 for RF and 2.59 for RF+LZN, LZN ImageNet top-1 accuracy of 69.5%, and joint-model CIFAR10 accuracy of 94.47%.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations, Theorem 1 and its proof are unchanged. Section 2.2.1 now says the desiderata are satisfied approximately, matching the approximation argument already present in v1 Appendix A.1.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same unified-framework contribution, three application levels, performance claims and task-synergy claim. The scope of the central contributions is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of task synergy, minibatch effects, performance gaps, computational cost and applicability limits are retained, including Sections 6 and Appendix G. The main-text approximation qualification repeats a limitation already explained in v1 Appendix A.1.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, pseudocode, hardware and training-time disclosures remain unchanged throughout the appendices. The code, trained-model and project access information is also retained.

R1.justification: Section 3 expands the RCG discussion to include Diffusion Autoencoder, distinguishing their representation training and auxiliary generative models from LZN's Gaussian representations and single-stage training. Distilled Decoding 2 is also cited; the broader research positioning and Appendix F remain unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized prose edits: the Section 3 related-work rewrite, the approximation qualification, movement of the early-step-cutoff heading, and an expanded decoder cross-reference. Author affiliation, acknowledgements and the version-update footnote also change; the overall section structure is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 2 revises the image examples illustrating latent zones, and Figure 3 redraws the schematic partitions and adjusts their presentation. The author block and some spacing change, while the empirical figures and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revised zone diagrams, more informative comparison with Diffusion Autoencoder in Section 3, and main-text wording consistent with Appendix A.1 improve clarity and research positioning. These are limited gains: the method, theoretical analysis and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
